# Slasher: Chicken Mask
[color=#ac3a0d]"Do you like hurting other people?"[/color]
The Chicken Mask is a prestige kit - ascend (reach 15 souls) as the [bold]Butcher[/bold] to unlock it.
## What's different
- [bold]Hotline vision.[/bold] Gives your game a unique view, complete with a drunk cam.
- [bold]Shared dread.[/bold] Victims you hunt get the same pulled-back hotline vision.
Everything else - soul steal, jaunt, massacre, meat spikes, regeneration - works exactly like the default Slasher.
## How to play
1. Unlock it by ascending as the Butcher, then select the Chicken Mask. 2. Use the wider top-down view to track multiple targets and avoid getting flanked. 3. Lean on blunt damage and staggers to knock victims down, then grab and spike them.
